categoryPickerSuggestions.title: Suggested categories and rules
categoryPickerSuggestions.body: The categories this transaction most likely belongs to are at the top. Pick one, then apply it — switch on the rule and similar transactions get it too, now and from now on.

dateQuickPicks.title: Quick dates
dateQuickPicks.body: Today, yesterday and two days ago are one tap away above the calendar. On a keyboard, the arrow keys move between days and Enter picks one.

searchActions.title: Search can do things too
searchActions.body: Before you type, search shows quick actions like adding a transaction or importing a CSV. Use the arrow keys to move through the results and Enter to open one.

debtDirection.title: Which way does it go?
debtDirection.body: Choose whether you owe this money or someone owes it to you. Money owed to you counts as an asset, not a debt.

debtIcon.title: Icon and colour
debtIcon.body: Pick a colour, or tap the icon to choose another symbol. It's how you'll recognise this debt in lists and charts.

debtBalanceDate.title: Balance as of
debtBalanceDate.body: Which date the balance belongs to. Leave it on today and it's simply what you owe now. Move it back and the app assumes the monthly payment was made every month since.

debtStartDate.title: Start date
debtStartDate.body: When the debt began. It sets the day of the month payments fall on and, if you add interest, when it starts accruing.

debtMinPayment.title: Monthly payment
debtMinPayment.body: What gets paid each month. This drives the payoff date. Link a recurring bill below and this fills in by itself.

debtOriginalAmount.title: Original amount
debtOriginalAmount.body: Only needed if you started tracking after already paying part of it off. Leave it alone to use the balance above as the total.

debtInterest.title: Interest
debtInterest.body: Optional. Add a yearly percentage and each payment will cover that month's interest first, so the payoff date reflects what you actually owe.

debtAutoBill.title: Create a recurring bill too
debtAutoBill.body: Turns this debt into a monthly bill automatically, so the payment shows up on your calendar and budget without entering it twice.

debtNote.title: Note
debtNote.body: Anything you want to remember about this debt — who it's with, the agreement, an account number.

debtLinkedBills.title: Link an existing bill
debtLinkedBills.body: Already have a recurring bill for this? Link it and your real payments will drive the progress instead of an assumed schedule.

debtHelp.title: Sums and this tour
debtHelp.body: Amount fields take sums too, like 120+35. Tap this button to replay this walkthrough.

debtSave.title: Save
debtSave.body: Available once the debt has a name and a balance above zero. That's everything — you're set.

savingIcon.title: Icon and colour
savingIcon.body: Pick a colour, or tap the icon to choose a symbol. It's how you'll spot this goal in your list of savings.

savingTarget.title: Target amount
savingTarget.body: What you're saving towards. You can type a sum, like 250*12, and it's worked out for you.

savingDates.title: Start and end date
savingDates.body: Set an end date and the monthly amount is worked out for you — target minus what you have, spread over the months left.

savingMonthly.title: Monthly contribution
savingMonthly.body: What you plan to put aside each month. Setting an end date below calculates this instead, and takes priority.

savingBalance.title: Starting balance
savingBalance.body: How much you've already saved towards this goal, so progress doesn't start from zero.

savingCategory.title: Category
savingCategory.body: Optional. Link a category so transactions in it count towards this goal automatically.

savingHelp.title: This walkthrough
savingHelp.body: Replay it from here whenever you like.

savingSave.title: Save
savingSave.body: Available once the goal has a name and a target above zero.

savingClose.title: Cancel
savingClose.body: Leaves without saving. That's everything — you're set.

receiptScan.title: Scan a receipt
receiptScan.body: Take a photo and Arca fills in the merchant, amount and date. Reading happens on this device — the photo never leaves it.

csvImport.title: Import from your bank
csvImport.body: Drop in a CSV export and Arca matches the columns, skips duplicates and categorises what it recognises.

recurring.title: Things that repeat
recurring.body: Bills, subscriptions and income you add here are matched to your transactions and feed your budget and forecast.

debtLinkedPayment.title: Linked bill sets the payment
debtLinkedPayment.body: Link a recurring bill to a debt and its monthly amount becomes the debt's minimum payment. Type a different figure in Minimum monthly payment to override it.

recurringWholeWord.title: Match a whole word
recurringWholeWord.body: Auto-match can now require your text to stand alone as a word, so a short pattern stops catching longer names it happens to sit inside.

merchant.title: Merchant profile
merchant.body: Every shop you pay gets its own page: what you spend there, how often, and how that has changed over the years.

merchantVisits.title: Month by month
merchantVisits.body: Each bar is what you spent here in that month; months still to come are striped. With more than a year of history, switch to one bar per year.

categoryMerchants.title: Where it went
categoryMerchants.body: The shops behind this category's total, biggest first, next to the latest transactions. Tap a transaction to open it.

recurringCharges.title: Every charge at a glance
recurringCharges.body: The last 12 charges of this recurring item. When the price changes, the change is called out here.

recurringMatchPreview.title: See what it will match
recurringMatchPreview.body: As you type the match pattern or amount, this chart shows the past charges it picks up, so you can check the rule before you save.

budgetCategoryDetail.title: Open a category
budgetCategoryDetail.body: Tap a category to see where the money went, its pace and the last months. The pencil edits its budget.

budget.title: Your budget
budget.body: Set one overall limit, then fine-tune per category. Arca tracks whether you are ahead of or behind pace for the month.

budgetStrategy.title: Budget strategy
budgetStrategy.body: Split your income across needs, wants and savings. Arca turns that split into an advised monthly budget.

reports.title: Reports
reports.body: Trends, month-to-month comparisons and net worth, over whichever period you pick at the top.

forecast.title: Cash flow forecast
forecast.body: Projects your balance forward from your recurring items and usual spending, so you can see dips before they happen.

health.title: Financial health
health.body: One score out of 100, built from your savings, buffer, budget, fixed costs, debt and income. The breakdown shows exactly where it comes from.

keyboardShortcuts.title: Arca on a keyboard
keyboardShortcuts.body: Ctrl+K (⌘K on a Mac) opens search from anywhere, Esc closes whatever is on top, and your numpad types amounts — with Enter to save.

importBalance.title: Bring your balance along
importBalance.body: If your export has a balance column, point it out here. Arca stores your bank's own figure untouched, ready for balance history and better forecasts.

budgetLocation.title: Your budget lives here
budgetLocation.body: Tap the wallet to set an overall limit and, if you want, a target per category.

healthCard.title: How you are doing overall
healthCard.body: Tap for your financial health score, what each part contributes, and the changes that would lift it most.

reportsLocation.title: Trends and forecasts
reportsLocation.body: The chart icon opens your reports: spending over time, month-to-month comparisons, net worth and cash flow.

settingsLocation.title: Everything else is behind your photo
settingsLocation.body: Accounts, categories, recurring items and all your preferences live in there.

transactionDetail.title: Tap for the whole story
transactionDetail.body: Open any transaction to recategorise it, split it, attach a receipt or jump to the merchant.

googleLookup.title: Who charged me?
googleLookup.body: Open a transaction and tap the Google button to search the shop name on the web — handy for a charge you don’t recognise.

strategyLocation.title: Your split lives in here
strategyLocation.body: Tap edit, then the sliders icon, to change how your income divides across needs, wants and savings — Arca re-advises your budget from it.

importDatePreview.title: Check the dates first
importDatePreview.body: This shows exactly what your date column turns into. If it says "not a date", you've picked the wrong column or format — fix it here and nothing broken gets imported.

importCheck.title: Nothing is imported yet
importCheck.body: Check the preview first: you see which rows are new and which duplicates are skipped. Only Import adds them.

importMapColumns.title: Bank read wrong, or not at all?
importMapColumns.body: Map columns lets you pick the date, description and amount columns yourself. Arca saves it as a profile for next time.

importHeaderRow.title: Account details above your columns?
importHeaderRow.body: Some banks start the file with a few lines about the account. Pick the row with the column names here and Arca skips everything above it.

dataHealth.title: Something imported wrong?
dataHealth.body: Data Health finds transactions with an unreadable date — the kind an import with the wrong column mapping leaves behind — and lets you correct or delete them.

bulkSelect.title: Hold to select several
bulkSelect.body: Press and hold any transaction to turn on selection mode. Pick as many as you like, then recategorise, exclude from reports, or delete them all at once.

sharedCost.title: Split a bill you pay in full
sharedCost.body: Mark the part housemates or family pay you back. Your cash flow keeps the whole charge — it really leaves your account — while reports can show only your own share.

planHub.title: Budget, debts and goals together
planHub.body: Switch between your budget, your debts and your savings goals here. They're all part of Plan now.

homeComingUp.title: Coming up
homeComingUp.body: The next bills this month, soonest first. The link opens the full list, where you can mark one as paid.

activityDetail.title: Everything about a transaction
activityDetail.body: Category, your share, merchant, note and receipt, plus split, link a Tikkie, make recurring or create a rule. More actions sit behind the ⋯ button.

activityFilters.title: Filter chips
activityFilters.body: Narrow the list by period, account, category, needs/wants/save, recurring, amount or direction. Tap the × on a chip to clear it.

activitySelectMode.title: Select several at once
activitySelectMode.body: Tap Select, hold a row, or Shift-click.

activitySearchBar.title: Search sits at the bottom
activitySearchBar.body: Search your transactions from the bar just above the tab bar, within thumb reach. It filters the list as you type.

activityHistory.title: History in one tap
activityHistory.body: This row shows what you spent at this merchant this period, or when a recurring payment comes next. Tap it for the last 12 months or the last 12 payments.

activityKeys.title: Move with the arrow keys
activityKeys.body: Press ↑ and ↓ to step through the list; the transaction on the right follows.

activityDetailTabs.title: Summary and bank details
activityDetailTabs.body: Summary shows what a payment is and what it did to your budget. Details shows everything the bank sent along, like the IBAN and reference, with copy buttons.

budgetMove.title: Move budget in one tap
budgetMove.body: When a category runs hot, Arca suggests moving budget from a category with room to spare. Your overall budget stays the same.

billStatusControl.title: auto, Paid and Paid?
billStatusControl.body: auto: Arca ticks the bill off itself when the payment arrives. Paid: it is due and no payment was found. Paid?: Arca can't tell, so say so yourself or teach Arca the pattern.

budgetNeedsCategory.title: Still without a category
budgetNeedsCategory.body: No category budget sees these transactions yet. Sort them and what is left per category is right again.

budgetPeriodNav.title: Look back at earlier months
budgetPeriodNav.body: Use the arrows next to the dates to see how an earlier budget month ended: what you spent, which categories went over, and which bills were paid.

budgetAddCategory.title: Everything in one place
budgetAddCategory.body: Your overall budget, the strategy and every category budget now sit together. Add categories one at a time; what each spent this period shows under its name.

debtsDetail.title: Everything about one debt
debtsDetail.body: Open a debt to see its linked bill, how much of each payment is interest and every payment still to come. The pencil edits it.

debtsSimulator.title: Try paying a bit extra
debtsSimulator.body: Slide to see how much sooner you are debt-free and how much interest you save. The payoff timeline follows along.

debtsSortAndImpact.title: Your order, your month
debtsSortAndImpact.body: Choose how the extra is shared out; Your debts follow the same order. Below it, what the extra leaves you to spend each month.

debtsOrder.title: Three ways to pay off
debtsOrder.body: Quickest win first pays off the smallest balance first, so a debt is gone as soon as possible. Highest interest first goes after the most expensive debt, which saves the most interest. Spread over all debts splits the extra equally, so every balance goes down each month.

debtsOwed.title: Money coming back to you
debtsOwed.body: Debts others owe you and advances that are only partly paid back. Mark one as settled once it is done.

debtsPayoffDates.title: Each debt's own finish line
debtsPayoffDates.body: Every debt shows the month it is paid off. Slide the extra payment and the dates move along, in the order your debts are sorted.

goalsContributions.title: What you put aside
goalsContributions.body: Twelve months of money moved into your goals, from the transactions linked to them. This month is the bright bar.

goalsDetail.title: When you get there
goalsDetail.body: Open a goal to see its history and, at your monthly amount, the month you reach it. You can edit it from there too.

goalsSuggestions.title: Start from a suggestion
goalsSuggestions.body: Use this fills in a name, icon and colour for a common first goal. Add your own amounts and change anything before you save.

insightsMerchants.title: Where the money went
insightsMerchants.body: Your biggest merchants this period, with how many visits made up each total.

insightsHealthNextStep.title: What would lift your score
insightsHealthNextStep.body: The step worth the most points, where you stand against its target, and what it takes to get there.

insightsHealthHistory.title: Your score, month by month
insightsHealthHistory.body: Each budget month's score next to its income, expenses, savings rate and net worth. The month in progress is marked so far.

insightsComingUp.title: What's coming
insightsComingUp.body: The next booked and expected payments in your forecast. Switch to Calendar to see every day with money moving, and tap a payment for its details.

insightsForecastRange.title: 30 days or 3 months
insightsForecastRange.body: Switch the forecast between the next 30 days and the next 3 months. The numbers and the status next to it follow along.

accountsAdd.title: Add accounts and assets
accountsAdd.body: Give a bank account its IBAN so imported rows land on it, and a starting balance so the total matches your bank. Savings, investments and things you own go under Add asset.

addTransactionAnother.title: Add several in a row
addTransactionAnother.body: Save and add another keeps this open for the next one, with the same date and account. Pick a category to see what the amount does to its budget before you save.

correctAmountPreview.title: See the budget change
correctAmountPreview.body: While you type the corrected amount, this shows what it does to the category's budget this period.

receiptViewer.title: Read the small print
receiptViewer.body: Zoom in on the receipt, or download the photo to keep a copy somewhere else.

rulePreview.title: Check the rule before you save
rulePreview.body: While you edit the description, match or amount, this shows which earlier transactions the rule picks up. Test shows what saving would change on the last 90 days.

splitSharedCost.title: Paid for others too?
splitSharedCost.body: Turn this on when others pay you back. Your cash flow keeps the full charge, while reports can show only your own share.

linkSearchOlder.title: Not in the list?
linkSearchOlder.body: The list shows recent expenses. Search to find an older one by name.

upcomingMonthNav.title: Look back or ahead
upcomingMonthNav.body: Use the arrows to see which bills were paid in an earlier month, or what is coming up next month.

upcomingNextMonth.title: Next month, before it starts
upcomingNextMonth.body: What next month's bills come to, what is new (a payment plan's first part) and what drops out, so the jump is explained before it hits.

billSkip.title: Skip a month
billSkip.body: Not saving this month? Skip the transfer and it drops out of every total for this month only. Next month it is back as usual.

needsReviewTriage.title: One at a time
needsReviewTriage.body: Pick a category and press Save and next (or Enter). Switch on the rule and similar transactions get that category from now on.

needsReviewBulk.title: Sort several at once
needsReviewBulk.body: Tap Select to pick several transactions from the queue and give them a category in one go.

financialMonthDays.title: Tap a day to set your start
financialMonthDays.body: Your month now starts on the day you tap, and it saves straight away. The bar below shows where today sits in the period.

financialMonthExceptions.title: Month overrides moved here
financialMonthExceptions.body: A different start day for a single month now lives right here, under your usual start day.

merchantsWithoutIcon.title: Find merchants without a logo
merchantsWithoutIcon.body: Switch to Without icon to see only the merchants that still have no logo, then open one to give it one.

privacyEye.title: Hide your amounts
privacyEye.body: Tap the eye to turn every amount into dots, on every screen, until you tap it again. Handy when someone is looking over your shoulder.

homeSafeToSpendSum.title: One number, with its sum
homeSafeToSpendSum.body: Safe to spend is your budget minus what you've spent and the bills still to come. The line under the bar shows exactly that sum.

homeIncomeVsSpending.title: Income vs spending
homeIncomeVsSpending.body: Six budget months side by side: money in as dark bars, money out striped. This month's spending is the solid orange bar.

clearNavigation.title: Everything is in the sidebar
clearNavigation.body: Home, Activity, Plan and Insights sit on the left, with Import, Settings, the theme and Sign out underneath. On a phone they're in the bar at the bottom.

settingsNav.title: Every setting in one list
settingsNav.body: Accounts, categories, recurring items, imports, appearance and your profile are all listed here. Pick one to open it.

homeMoneyFlow.title: Money flow
homeMoneyFlow.body: Money in and money out this month, added up day by day. The gap between the two lines today is what you've kept so far.

homeNetWorth.title: Net worth on Home
homeNetWorth.body: What you own minus what you owe, how it moved this month and the last six months as a line. Tap a row to open your accounts, goals or debts.

homeBudgetLink.title: Your budget moved
homeBudgetLink.body: The budget card is gone: Safe to spend already shows the budget. Tap the budget figure here to open the Budget page.

budgetStrategyTarget.title: Target against actual
budgetStrategyTarget.body: Each kind shows its target share of income (striped) above what you actually spent or saved so far. Tap Adjust to change the split.

budgetUnbudgeted.title: Spending without a budget
budgetUnbudgeted.body: Spending in categories without their own budget now shows under the list, so you can see what eats into the free money.

globalSearch.title: Search moved
globalSearch.body: Search finds anything across the app — transactions, merchants, categories, settings. It now lives in the sidebar (and at the end of the bar on phones), so it is clear it searches everywhere, not just this page. Ctrl/Cmd+K still works.

categoryPickerByGroup.title: Categories, by group
categoryPickerByGroup.body: Every category sits under its group, like Housing or Transport. Type a group's name to see all of its categories, use the arrow keys to move and Enter to pick.

categoryGroups.title: Groups add up
categoryGroups.body: Categories now sit in groups like Housing, which add up everything inside them. Tap a group to fold it, or its pencil to rename it or change its colour.

insightsGroupSwitch.title: Spending by group
insightsGroupSwitch.body: See what a whole group cost, like everything for the house, or switch to Categories for the details.

insightsRunningTotal.title: Your month as a line
insightsRunningTotal.body: The black line is what you spent so far, day by day. The grey one is the period before, the dotted one where this pace ends, and the orange dashed line is your budget.

insightsBlockMap.title: Area is money
insightsBlockMap.body: The bigger the block, the more that group cost, with the change since last period. Tap a block for the categories in it.

insightsMovers.title: What changed, with the numbers
insightsMovers.body: The categories that went up or down most per month against the months before, from and to. Compare two months opens the month comparison.

insightsNetWorthChanges.title: Why your net worth moved
insightsNetWorthChanges.body: This month's change split into contributions, debt paid down, values entered by hand and cash. A dip before payday is normal.

accountsOverdraft.title: Accounts that may go into the red
accountsOverdraft.body: Open a bank account to set how far below zero it may go. The forecast then only calls it a shortfall past that limit, and you choose whether the overdraft counts as money to spend.

paymentPlan.title: Pay a cost in parts
paymentPlan.body: Choose Payment plan for a bill you pay off in parts, like the dentist. Enter the total and the number of parts, and each part shows up in the month it's due.

aiSettings.title: AI with Gemini or your own server
aiSettings.body: Add a free Gemini API key or your own AI server here to get category suggestions and a summary of your spending. It's off until you switch it on.

aiCategories.title: Let AI suggest a category
aiCategories.body: Ask AI suggests categories for this transaction and the next ones in the queue. Its pick is marked with a sparkle; you still choose.

insightsSummary.title: Three facts and what's left
insightsSummary.body: This card sums up the period in three facts and what's left to spend per day. With AI on, it can write them up with a budgeting tip.

iconPicker.title: One picker for icons, logos and colour
iconPicker.body: Search finds icons and brand logos at once, and the colour row recolours every tile, so you see the result before you choose.

ruleTeach.title: Teach it once
ruleTeach.body: Picked a category? Tap Always and every transaction from this merchant is filed the same way, now and on every import.

merchantPatterns.title: One place per merchant
merchantPatterns.body: Add the descriptions your bank uses for this merchant and give it a category: its logo, name and category then follow every transaction.

bankConnection.title: Connect your bank
bankConnection.body: Paste your Enable Banking app here and connect a bank: transactions then come in by themselves every day, no CSV needed.

quickAdd.title: Add from anywhere
quickAdd.body: The + next to search (the orange button on phones) adds a transaction, recurring bill, debt, goal or category without leaving the page you are on. Ctrl/Cmd+N opens it too.

reviewTeach.title: Teach the busy ones
reviewTeach.body: Merchants with a pile of transactions waiting show up here. File one, tap Always, and the rest are sorted at once.

recentChanges.title: Undo a bulk change
recentChanges.body: Every import, rule run, bulk move and delete is listed here. Undo puts it back, as long as nothing later changed the same rows.

helpGuide.title: Help is one tap away
helpGuide.body: The Arca guide explains every page step by step. Open Help any time to find it, or to report a problem or idea.

userInvites.title: Invite people with a link
userInvites.body: Sign-up is closed: nobody can create an account on their own any more. Make an invite link here and send it to someone who should join. It works once and expires after a week.

recurringSuggestions.title: Regular payments, found for you
recurringSuggestions.body: Arca looks for payments that come back at a steady rhythm and amount. Nothing becomes a bill until you accept it; Not a bill keeps it from coming back.

recurringScan.title: Check your whole history
recurringScan.body: Imports only re-check the shops and people they touched. This looks through everything for payments that come back at a steady rhythm.

debtsWhereExtraGoes.title: Where the extra goes
debtsWhereExtraGoes.body: One row per debt: its minimum, the extra it gets now and what you pay. When a debt is paid off, its whole payment moves on to the others, so the plan reads month by month.

debtsPaymentsMonth.title: This month's payments
debtsPaymentsMonth.body: Each debt's payment this month: paid once it matches its bill, or say Paid? yourself for a debt without one. Log a payment adds an extra or a lump sum, and it comes straight off the balance.

whatsNew.title: Arca was updated
whatsNew.body: Settings › About lists everything that changed in this version.

backups.title: Your own backups
backups.body: Arca already copies the database before every update. Back up now makes one on the spot, and the download button keeps a copy somewhere else.

importTabs.title: Import lives here now
importTabs.body: CSV file and Bank connection are two tabs in one place. The dot on Bank connection means a consent ran out.

updateCheck.title: Want to hear about new versions?
updateCheck.body: Arca never calls home on its own. Turn this on and the server asks GitHub once a day which version is newest.

updateAvailable.title: A newer Arca is out
updateAvailable.body: Update when it suits you; Arca backs the database up first.

betaBuild.title: This is a test build
betaBuild.body: You are running a dev or local build of Arca, not a release. Your real install shows no Beta chip.

betaChanges.title: What is in this build
betaChanges.body: Every change since the last release, newest first, so you can see whether yours is in yet.

aiProvider.title: Gemini or your own server
aiProvider.body: Pick Local server to use Ollama, LM Studio or another AI server on your own network instead of Google.

bankAccountType.title: The bank says what kind of account it is
bankAccountType.body: Arca sets that type when you link the account. You can change it later in Settings › Accounts.

reviewTransfer.title: Money to your own account
reviewTransfer.body: Pick Internal transfer for money to one of your own accounts, also one that isn't in Arca. It stays out of your budgets and spending.

aiPicksKept.title: AI suggestions are kept
aiPicksKept.body: What AI suggested earlier is still here after a reload, marked with a sparkle. Arca won't ask again for these transactions.

ruleMatches.title: See what a rule files
ruleMatches.body: Open the list to see every transaction the new rule files now, and untick the ones it should leave alone.

reviewBulkRules.title: One category, a rule per merchant
reviewBulkRules.body: Picked several? Choose Category and switch on the rule: Arca makes one rule for each merchant. Hold a row, or Shift-click it, to start selecting.

iconPickerAllIcons.title: Every icon is here now
iconPickerAllIcons.body: Under the suggested icons you find all 5,000+ Tabler icons: search by name or browse a category.

notifications.title: Notifications live here now
notifications.body: Bills due soon, a forecast running low, new transactions: Arca collects them on this page.

pushDevice.title: Get them on your phone
pushDevice.body: Turn push on per device. On iPhone, add Arca to your home screen first.

regularPayments.body: Arca looks for bills, subscriptions and income that come back at a steady rhythm and amount. It checks what each import touches; run it here to check your whole history.
